scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Courage & Bravery
other_conditions: Nominee must be a senior citizen who has displayed exemplary courage in the face of grave danger.
Award is open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized nominating agency or individual; self‑nominations are not considered.
The award recognizes protection of human rights, national security or mitigation of social evils, and sustainable efforts for protecting lives in society.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹2,50,000 along with a citation, memento and travel/lodging expenses covered by the Government.
